shared_suffix: photorealistic, ultra-high definition, 8K resolution, commercial photography quality, sharp details, professional lighting. CRITICAL: keep the product EXACTLY the same — same structure, same proportions, same color, do not modify any design detail.

white_bg.name: 白底正面图
white_bg.role: 产品身份证，最干净锚点
white_bg.prompt_template: {product}, displayed centered on pure white background (RGB 255,255,255), product occupies 90% of frame, front view or slight 45-degree angle, clean studio lighting with very subtle natural shadow underneath, no props, no decorations, no text, no watermark
white_bg.note: 走「生图 + rembg 抠图合成」两段式，别一步生成

studio.name: 商拍图
studio.prompt_template: professional studio product photography, model wearing {product}, keep the product IDENTICAL to the reference image, softbox key light + rim light, {material} texture visible, clean neutral seamless background, shallow depth of field

lifestyle.name: 氛围图
lifestyle.role: 场景代入（卖给谁/什么场景）
lifestyle.prompt_template: lifestyle photo, model wearing {product} in {scene}, {persona}, natural light, shallow depth of field, product in focus, authentic atmosphere, scene-appropriate props

detail.name: 细节图
detail.prompt_template: macro photography, extreme close-up of {detail_point} on {product}, directional side lighting highlighting {material} texture and {craft}, fill the frame with the detail, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh background
detail.note: 优先图生图/局部重绘，别文生图凭空造纹理

fabric.name: 面料结构图
fabric.note: 模板按 sku.fabric_type 分 5 支（knit/print/leather/down/texture），见 prompts.FABRIC_TEMPLATES
